$parts.$description: The player (watch169-1280-L): icons white #FFFFFF by pixel; the seek line 4 high (y502–505) with a 12 dot (x28–39, y498–509); autoplay on is a white track 30×18 (x649–678, y526–543) with a black 14 knob inset 2 (x664–677, y528–541), centred in its 48 slot (its label is hidden, so no gap).
The time pill's words are #EEEEEE, a step under the icons' white (watch169-1280-L).

The add-comment field runs the comments' width to x879 with its line at y135 (WC-1280-L: box y111–136, text from x52). The reference's text sits high in its box (ink y114–124, 11 above the line), so the field here is 31 high: the text centres 3 higher while the line stays put (the row's top margin gives the 6 back, site.css).
Format marks: 4K is 18 high, radius 2, a 1 px #CCCCCC edge (S-1280-L x612–633, y527–544; dark unmeasured).

The chapters strip: radius 8 (corner run 4, 3, 2, 1), a cool tint, #F4F1F8 light and #2C2733 dark (S-1280-L/D, the same tint in both captures), and a 24 expand glyph whose 14×8 ink sits at x1225 (12 from the strip's end).

Sort by has no inline padding and 8 between glyph and words: its glyph's ink starts 36 after the count's ink and its words 30 after the glyph's ink (WC-1280-L: count ink to x219, glyph 255–274, words from 285).

$description: Q145.Y reference spec .design-library/youtube-ref/README.md (headless, signed out, 1280/1440/720, light and dark). Sources are capture ids: H home, S search, G guide open, C channel grid, T hashtag grid, W watch; L light, D dark. Type: Roboto (OFL) from the font registry, the reference's own face. Unmeasured values say so.
